title.zh: LAY A 决策引擎与拟人化运行时重构
title.en: Refactor LAY A decision engine and persona runtime

intent.zh: 把 LAY A 从单一分类模型提升为低延迟结构化裁决层，并补齐人格、关系、记忆、缓存幂等与 shadow 评估边界。
intent.en: Elevate LAY A from a classifier into a low-latency structured arbitration layer, while defining persona, relationship, memory, idempotency, caching, and shadow-evaluation boundaries.

acceptance: LAY A 的批量结构化决策契约明确，包含 context、persona、relationship、local_gates、laya 和 final 边界
本地硬门始终优先于 LAY A 建议，模型不可绕过 cooldown、flood、rate limit、敏感风险和发送幂等
提供 off、shadow、active 三种运行模式，shadow 不改变真实动作并记录分歧、置信度和延迟
人格、关系和记忆状态与快速决策解耦，决策只读取压缩快照，不直接改写长期记忆
窗口 fingerprint、TTL 缓存和 flow 幂等键设计完成并有回归测试
全量测试通过，Normify validate 0 errors
note:
团队规划阶段：四个独立设计任务已登记。当前只建立 planned 结构与验收边界，不进入源码实现；已知硬边界：LAY A 不接管 behavior/interrupt score，不绕过本地硬门；纯数值 state 已被真实实验否定，必须保留自然语言语境并 shadow 对照。
Implemented auditable decision packet, immutable persona/runtime snapshots, TTL/LRU and single-flight cache primitives, and wired off/shadow/active behavior classification modes. Fake OneBot replays and full regression completed; real API skipped because no credentials are configured.
